newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary c.bank to issue one-yr bond on June 20.
newsitem.headline: Hungary c.bank to issue one-yr bond on June 20.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on Tuesday that it will issue a one-year bond to domestic investors on June 20, the NBH said in a statement on Tuesday.
"The main aim of the issue of the NBH bond is that the central bank should meet the demand for one-year securities without any limitations on the amount," the NBH said.

This will be the first time the central bank sells its own bonds on the domestic market. The central bank will issue the bonds when the amount of government securities it has is not sufficient for its open market operations, the NBH said.
The NBH did not disclose what amount it would it issue on June 20 and at what yield levels.
